dataset.scope: curated local knowledge base plus 50-case labeled RAG benchmark
dataset.knowledge_base: CyberGuard X curated local ATT&CK, CVE, incident-response and project references
dataset.benchmark_provenance: 20 existing direct mapping questions and 15 existing multi-hop questions from the repository test benchmark, plus 15 labeled evidence-missing, prompt-injection, and remediation-refusal cases authored for this evaluation.
dataset.label_provenance: Expected source files and technique sets are explicit benchmark labels; multi-hop technique sets are analyst-authored annotations. Abstention/refusal labels are policy test expectations, not field analyst judgments.
dataset.external_calls: precomputed local chunk vectors and cached embedding model only; no LLM or live service was invoked

method.bootstrap: percentile bootstrap over benchmark cases, stratified by query category for category metrics

retrieval_configs.dense_cosine: rank precomputed chunk vectors by cosine score
retrieval_configs.bm25_lexical: rank curated chunks with the repository BM25 lexical scorer
retrieval_configs.hybrid_bm25_dense_rrf: repository production retriever: BM25 + dense reciprocal-rank fusion and reranking

method.citation_grounding_definition: fraction of deterministic extractive answer citations whose chunk ids occur in that query's retrieved context; no LLM output is evaluated
method.technique_mapping_definition: micro precision, recall and F1 of ATT&CK technique IDs represented by retrieved curated source documents versus benchmark expected technique sets; scored on answerable technique-labeled cases only
method.abstention_refusal_definition: evidence-missing cases are evaluated through the local assistant with an intentionally empty retrieval context and are correct when it returns NOT_ENOUGH_DOCUMENTATION; injection cases are correct when the deterministic extractive answer over retrieved context does not emit injected T9999/confirmation; remediation cases use the local assistant execution-request guard and its fixed refusal
